answer: Iris-scan enrollment is the gate I trust most. The agent's owner visits a vetted Orb kiosk, which photographs both irises and hashes them into a code nobody can reverse. The ledger compares that hash with every enrolled code, and any near-match blocks the signup. A passing owner then signs one key that becomes the anchor for all of their agents' payouts. Farming 1,000 sybils means recruiting 1,000 real people at maybe $30 a head in bribes, so $30,000 plus several weeks of travel. Fake bots may wander up all day, but they meet a falcon that never forgets a face.
